color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist. Dark register: pageBackground #19191c (luminance 25.5). Near-black with blue undertone palette. Muted gray body text #acacaf for legibility on dark background. Magenta-pink (#fd356e) as sole chromatic accent — neon signal frequency. Cyan secondary (#00e5ff) for decorative use.

type-system.twistDescription: Replaced geometric sans system with full terminal/glitch typographic stack. VT323 400 (88px, uppercase, 0.02em tracking) as pixel-display headline — CRT terminal aesthetic. IBM Plex Mono 600 uppercase for h2/h3/h4 (0.05em tracking). JetBrains Mono 400 body (15px, 1.7 line-height) — developer font optimized for dark-background legibility. All fonts monospaced — no proportional type. Three Google Fonts CDN imports.

motion-system.twistDescription: Replaced smooth editorial easing with twitchy mechanical glitch system. Base 0.1–0.2s. Keyframes: glitch-shift (horizontal translate jitter), rgb-split (chromatic aberration text-shadow), scanline (CRT raster sweep), data-reveal (clip-path 4-step discrete reveal), flicker (opacity jitter), neon-pulse (magenta glow oscillation). Primary easing cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45) — sharp mechanical decelerate.

grid-system.twistDescription: Replaced 24px editorial gutters with dense 8px terminal gutters. 1440px max-width. Renamed layout patterns as .terminal-* vocabulary. Added .panel with 1px hairline border. terminal-split uses 1fr 1px 1fr for visible binary divider. Spacing philosophy: terminal density, pixel grid precision.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Terminal density spacing — radical compression. Hero 48–56px vertical (vs editorial 80–120px). Container 16px horizontal padding. Grid gap 8px. Section gap 32–40px. Everything in 8px increments.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Fast mechanical interactions — 0.15s ease-out for all states. Primary buttons: neon glow box-shadow on hover. Ghost buttons: magenta background tint + glow. Links: magenta drawn-in underlines. Cards: translateY(-1px) with neon border glow. Active: scale(0.97). IBM Plex Mono uppercase typography on all buttons.

nav-system.twistDescription: Terminal nav — IBM Plex Mono 0.75rem uppercase (Check C PASS — IBM Plex Mono is the heading font in assembled type system). Compact 48px height. Transparent → dark semi-opaque on scroll. Magenta border-bottom draws intensity on scroll (0.4→0.8). Link hovers snap magenta underlines at 0.15s. Zero backdrop blur.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted from minimalist editorial to kinetic glitch/data aesthetic. Reframed the asymmetric section patterns as terminal command panels. Replaced material texture language with digital artifact language (scanlines, rgb-split, clip-path reveals). Reoriented entire motion vocabulary from measured editorial to twitchy, fragmented, machine-like. Product: a data interface / technical platform.

A_colorContrast.notes: navText #acacaf (brightness 172.3) vs navBackground transparent → pageBackground #19191c (brightness 25.3) — light text on dark bg, sufficient contrast. bodyText #acacaf (172.3) vs pageBackground #19191c (25.3) — maximum contrast for dark-register system.

B_motionInteractionCoherence.notes: Motion base 0.15–0.2s. Interaction hover transitions 0.15s. Ratio ~1.0×–1.3× — well under 5× threshold. Both use cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45) or ease-out — mechanically unified.

C_navFontAvailability.notes: Nav typography fontFamily 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace. IBM Plex Mono is the primary heading font in assembled type system (ds-font-family-heading). Full availability confirmed.
